arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, but I noticed it's quite minimal — there's not much content beyond your email. I'd suggest adding a short bio, a photo, and maybe some info about your interests or work to make it feel more personal and engaging. Also, you might want to double-check which email you'd like listed publicly, since I saw two different addresses. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking — that's a great topic with lots of potential for beautiful photos and trail stories. Right now the site is pretty sparse, so I'd suggest adding posts with details about your favorite hikes, tips for beginners, and some pictures to bring it to life. Keep it up!
